changes: Reproduced R1, then made runtime classification come only from the server registry and operation semantics come from trusted tool resolution. Unknown, malformed, failed and cross-tenant classification denies before executor invocation; caller declarations can tighten but cannot lower registry policy.

Applied protected-data controls to runtime actions and adapter guards, made no-AI-access invariant, preserved tenant-scoped classifications, and scrubbed protected targets, parameters, summaries, results and raw executor errors from audit, observer, journal and durable job data.

Added runtime and adapter regressions for R1, spoofed operations, unknown/service-failure/cross-tenant classification, protected reads and restore boundaries, plus an explicit ordinary-data success fixture.

Separated maintained platform source validation from historical reproducibility: validate no longer compares or overwrites platform/; historical-assemble-check assembles and verifies in a disposable temporary tree. Preserved platform/PROVENANCE.json and historical 00-core/ and 01-step1/. Updated root lifecycle documentation.

Follow-up to independent review of superseded 940043b: validate classifier-returned record class, noAiAccess, tenant and target binding even when a wrapper reports classified; public guard.evaluate resolves only server registry records and ignores caller record overrides; runtime log observer now classifies targets and redacts payloads unless an explicitly matching ordinary server record permits logging. Added a logger-ledger canary regression matching the verifier probe.
limitations: Independent verification and human acceptance are pending. This commit is not merged or deployed.
GitHub CI is NOT RUN. Windows conformance had 527/528 pass; the remaining failure is the known Windows path-containment issue in the out-of-scope S2-01 area. Linux conformance passed 528/528.
